from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

def answer(q: str, docs: list[str]) -> str:
    ctx = "\n".join(f"[{i+1}] {d}" for i, d in enumerate(docs))
    sys = "Answer with inline citations like [1], [2]. Only cite given sources."
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="{{model_name}}",
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": sys},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Sources:\n{ctx}\n\nQ: {q}"},
        ],
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content
